The business
A tent rental company for high-end events on Long Island. Profitable for 20 years, newly bought by a friend.
What I did
One season as product lead and operator, replacing what ran on memory with software.
Outcome
Payroll on Gusto, site plans in minutes instead of hours or days, and a roadmap for the rest.
The product
Dice: the shared tokens and components behind 28 betting brands and 40+ themes, including BetMGM, bwin and Ladbrokes.
What I did
Co-architected the token structure, the component library, and the adoption and governance models.
Outcome
One shared component for every brand instead of a copy per brand. Winner, Zeroheight Best Collaboration Award.
